name: cavemio-team-members
title: Team members
description: Settings → Members, done properly: invited addresses fly out of the field onto their rows, role pills grow into the list of roles, and seats roll.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The invite field is a tag input (combobox and chip list, with its keyboard and announcements). The role pills are buttons that open a listbox: arrows move the highlight, Enter picks, Escape folds it back and returns focus to the pill.
- Invites, role changes, refusals, resends and removals are announced in a status region outside the list. The resend countdown is hidden from screen readers; the button says when it can be used.
- You and locked members (an owner) can't be removed here, and a locked member's role is plain text.
- The chips' flight is a copy in an overlay, so the field and the list each settle on their own; rows glide with additive transforms and removed rows fold away as their own detached elements.
- Reduced motion adds, changes and removes in place; the role list opens and closes without growing.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: value
props.description: – · Controlled members and invites: { id, email, name?, image?, role, status?, invitedAt?, lastActiveAt?, you?, locked? }.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · The list after every invite, role change, resend and removal. New invites come first.

props.name: roles
props.description: – · Roles people can be given, in menu order. A member whose role isn't listed (an owner) shows it as plain text.

props.name: inviteRole
props.description: – · The role new invites start with. The second role by default.

props.name: seats
props.description: – · Seats on the plan. Members and pending invites each take one; the field takes no more than are left.

props.name: onInvite
props.description: – · Sends invites and returns the new members (status "invited"). Throw to keep the addresses and show the message. Without it there is no invite field.

props.name: onRoleChange
props.description: – · Saves a role; the pill changes at once and changes back if this throws. Without it roles are plain text.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: – · Removes a member or cancels an invite. Never offered for you or locked members.

props.name: onResend
props.description: – · Sends an invite again; the clock restarts from now.

props.name: resendAfter
props.description: 30 · Seconds before an invite can be sent again.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: – · People to suggest in the invite field, e.g. from your directory.

props.name: title
props.description: "Members" · Heading and the list's accessible name.

features.title: Invite many at once
features.description: Paste a list of addresses, pick the role they join as, and “Invite 3” sends them.

features.title: Invites land on their rows
features.description: Each chip lifts out of the field and flies onto its new row, where the avatar opens in.

features.title: Seats are counted
features.description: “4 of 6 seats” rolls as people come and go, turns amber when none are left, and the field takes no more than fit.

features.title: Roles change in place
features.description: A role pill grows into the list of roles. If your server refuses, the old role returns and the reason shows under the name.

features.title: Pending invites can be resent
features.description: A countdown, “Resend in 0:28”, becomes a Resend link that says Sending and Sent.

features.title: Removing asks first
features.description: The bin stretches into “Remove”, a check draws, then the row folds away. You and locked members, such as an owner, can’t be removed here.

states.title: invite
states.description: Addresses become chips in the invite field (tag input): pasted lists spill out of the caret, repeats fly into their twins and anything that isn't an address lands red. The button counts them: "Invite 3".

states.title: sending
states.description: Invite turns into "Inviting" while onInvite runs; the field holds still. If it throws, the addresses stay, the button says Try again and the reason takes the line under the field.

states.title: arrive
states.description: Each chip's copy lifts 6px out of the field and flies 680ms onto its row's name, 60ms after the one before, its outline fading as it lands; the name takes over and the avatar scales in from 0.6 out of a blur. The rows below glide down to make room.

states.title: seats
states.description: "4 of 6 seats" rolls with every invite and removal and turns amber when none are left; the field then refuses more and says how many fit.

states.title: role
states.description: The role pill's own surface grows from its right edge into the list of roles in 420ms (upward when there's no room below); the highlight glides between rows and a check draws beside the current one. Picking folds it back and the label morphs; a spinner replaces the chevron while onRoleChange runs.

states.title: refused
states.description: If onRoleChange throws, the old role morphs back, the pill shakes ±4px and the error's message lifts in over the line under the name for 3.6s.

states.title: resend
states.description: Pending invites say "Resend in 0:28", the seconds rolling down. Then Resend is a link; it morphs to Sending and Sent, the invite's time resets and the countdown opens again.

states.title: remove
states.description: The bin (or, for an invite, the crossed envelope) stretches into a red Remove / Cancel invite. A check draws, the row dims for 700ms, then folds away while the rest glide up.
